annotations.text:
DIRECTION: the desk's own palette and typefaces, at prose scale.
A stranger sees the instrument they will actually get, not a bright marketing page followed by a black terminal.

Bracketed text is a fact I do not have — operator name, access terms, contact, entity.

THIS PAGE IS THE ONE PIECE THAT CANNOT SHIP YET.
/ is the trader's board and Basic Auth is the only thing holding it.

Sign-in, states, privacy and terms can all ship now behind their own exempted prefixes, with the desk still locked.

A LIST OF ONE, not one button centred.
The group, its label and the stack all survive a second provider arriving; the second row is not drawn.

Google's button is used to Google's spec and not restyled to the desk — a restyled one is a verification risk and reads as a fake.

SIX STATES, EACH WITH THE STATUS CODE IT MUST SEND.
None of them says 'try again': with one provider that is a wall dressed as a door.

The refusal is a 403 that looks like a refusal. A denial rendering 200 has already happened here once.

SIGNED IN, NOT ADMITTED.
Invite-only makes this a real reachable state the day enforcement ships. A person here has a session and an account row - not a stranger.

The sign-in 403 card is superseded: sign-in succeeds and creates the row as pending. Refusal lands after the session, not inside the flow.
